doc.brief: The QTableWidgetSelectionRange class provides a way to interact with selection in a model without using model indexes and a selection model.
doc.index_brief: Way to interact with selection in a model without using model indexes and a selection model

QTableWidgetSelectionRange().brief: Constructs an empty table selection range, i.e. a range whose [rowCount](xref:qt:QTableWidgetSelectionRange)() and [columnCount](xref:qt:QTableWidgetSelectionRange)() are 0.

QTableWidgetSelectionRange(int top, int.brief: Constructs the table selection range from the given *top*, *left*, *bottom* and *right* table rows and columns.

bool operator!=(const QTableWidgetSelect.brief: Returns true if *lhs* and *rhs* are not equal, otherwise returns false.

bool operator==(const QTableWidgetSelect.brief: Returns true if *lhs* and *rhs* are equal, otherwise returns false.

int bottomRow() const.brief: Returns the bottom row of the range.

int columnCount() const.brief: Returns the number of columns in the range.

int leftColumn() const.brief: Returns the left column of the range.

int rightColumn() const.brief: Returns the right column of the range.

int rowCount() const.brief: Returns the number of rows in the range.

int topRow() const.brief: Returns the top row of the range.
